sentences.en: Unrequited love can easily become bitterness, anger, jealousy, and regret.
sentences.zh: 单恋很容易变成怨恨、愤怒、嫉妒和遗憾。

sentences.en: There was a savour of bitterness in his voice.
sentences.zh: 他的话语中带着一丝苦涩的味道。

sentences.en: There was a savour of bitterness in her voice.
sentences.zh: 她的话语中带有苦涩的味道。

phrases.zh: ……的苦涩：表示某种情感或语气中的苦涩味道。
